free_tier.stated: Test-drive 1 TB of Cubbit DS3 Cloud in a demo environment for 30 days; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: a one-time 30-day trial, not a recurring allowance. The paid price is a single flat rate per TB a month quoted through partners; no figure is published.

per_object_cap.stated: Maximum object size 5 TiB; multipart parts of 5 MiB to 5 GiB, 10,000 parts per upload

retention.stated: data uploaded during the free trial is permanently deleted when the trial expires
retention.notes: days is the trial length stated on the pricing page; the account itself remains active after the trial data is deleted.

egress.terms: a single flat rate per TB/month with no extra fees: no charges for egress, deletion, bucket replication, or API calls

interface_detail: ready-to-use, S3-compatible cloud object storage; data stored in partners' data centres in the EU or the UK in the selected regions
tooling: S3 clients and SDKs: the vendor documents the AWS CLI and multipart upload; rclone's s3 backend
chaining: An S3 origin with no egress or API charge; the 30-day 1 TB trial is a test environment, and recurring capacity is bought through a partner quote.

limits.value: 1 TB for 30 days on the trial
data uploaded during the trial is deleted when the trial expires

limits_note: Minimum chargeable object size 256KB: a smaller file is counted and billed as 256KB. Paid pricing is a flat rate per TB a month set by partner quote.
binding_note: the free path is a single 1 TB trial that ends after 30 days; after it every byte is on a partner-quoted price

identity_cost.detail: The trial sign-up at console.trial.cubbit.eu is self-service ('Sign up now and get started right away for free') and the pricing page states 'No credit card required' for the trial. The DS3 Cloud agreement linked from the sign-up page requires an account associated with a valid e-mail address, and the DS3 console quickstart has the user set a password and confirm the address through an emailed link. unverified: the sign-up form's own fields did not render through any reader, so a further required field is not excluded. Paid DS3 Cloud is sold through partners after a call or a form.

reliability_note: no throttle, suspension or data-loss event is stated on the pages read; the trial is a demo environment
confidence_note: the trial, the fee rule, the object cap and the minimum chargeable size are quoted from Cubbit's own pages read on 2026-10-30; the paid price is not published and the read path is unprobed.
